0022600197.text: The Lakers (8-2, first in the Pacific and first in the West) visit the Pistons (6-2, first in the Central and third in the East) on a four-game winning streak, and Los Angeles is 3-1 on the road. Detroit enters on a one-game losing streak, with a 2-1 home record, and is without Isaiah Joe (out, hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain). The teams have not played each other yet this season, and the Lakers lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 113-110 defeat in Detroit on March 23, 2026.
